canonical_title: Continuous Learning and Four Ways to Professional Development (CBLM 5)
aliases: What are the some ways to professional development?

one_line_answer.text: Professional development comes through mentoring, in-service training, industry visit and working with other teachers.

cites.quote: Some ways to professional development:
Professional development through mentoring
Professional development through in-service training and study
Professional development through industry visit
Professional development through working with other teachers

keywords.bn: একজন শিক্ষক আরেকজনকে শেখাতে সাহায্য করেন
সবসময় শিখতে থাকা ও পরিবর্তনের সাথে মানিয়ে নেওয়া
নিজের জ্ঞান ও দক্ষতা হালনাগাদ রাখা

bangla_explanation: পেশাগত উন্নয়নের ৪টি উপায়: mentoring, in service training and study, industry visit, আর অন্য teachers-এর সাথে কাজ।
Mentoring-এ একজন অভিজ্ঞ mentor অন্য শিক্ষকের teaching ভালো করতে সাহায্য করেন।
Industry visit-এ modern equipment and technology চেনা যায়।
Continuous learning মানে learning-কে সমর্থন করে এমন strategies প্রয়োগ আর change-এর সাথে adapt করা।

example.en: A welding instructor visits a local shipyard. He watches workers use new welding machines.
example.bn: কারখানায় গিয়ে নতুন মেশিন দেখে আসা মানেই industry visit।

list_answer.title: Ways to professional development

items.text: Mentoring: one teacher facilitates the learning of another.

cites.quote: Professional development through mentoring
Mentoring is when one teacher facilitates the learning of another.

items.text: In-service training and study: programs train teachers in new skills and update knowledge.

cites.quote: Professional development through in-service training and study
service training programs are often designed for specific purposes to train teachers in
new skills and update their knowledge in content

items.text: Industry visit: get familiar with modern equipment and technology.

cites.quote: Professional development through industry visit
Teachers can visit local industries to get familiar with the modern equipment and technology

items.text: Working with other teachers: visiting schools, workshops, seminars, teachers groups, talking.

cites.quote: Professional development through working with other teachers
Visiting teachers at other schools, attending in-service workshops, attending seminars
participating in teachers groups, talking to other teachers in your

items_bn: Mentoring — একজন শিক্ষক আরেকজন শিক্ষকের শেখাকে সহজ করে দেন।
In-service training and study — চাকরিরত অবস্থায় training নিয়ে নতুন skills শেখা আর জ্ঞান হালনাগাদ করা।
Industry visit — শিল্প-কারখানা ঘুরে modern equipment and technology-র সাথে পরিচিত হওয়া।
অন্য teachers-এর সাথে কাজ — অন্য schools-এ যাওয়া, workshops, seminars আর teachers groups-এ যোগ দেওয়া, আলাপ করা।

short.modelAnswer:

1. Professional development through mentoring

keyPoints.text: Continuous learning is the ability to apply learning strategies and adapt to change.

cites.quote: Continuous learning is the ability to apply strategies which support learning and the ability to adapt to change.

keyPoints.text: We learn as part of regular work, from co-workers, and in training.

cites.quote: We use this skill when we learn as part of regular work or from co-workers and when we access training

keyPoints.text: Currency includes technical expertise and professional practice as a trainer or assessor.

vocational competency and/or technical expertise in subject matter
professional practice as a trainer/facilitator, assessor
